## PDF page 1

[Open source PDF](../../../../sources/pdf/GTO/Getting-The-Answer-Key.pdf#page=1)

```text
                 The Answer Key
There are two identical versions of the answer key:

  • The online version via Google Sheets
  • The downloadable version

The Google Sheet has been locked to ensure nobody accidently
deletes an answer. If you already use Google Drive you can add it
to your own Drive by going to File > Make A Copy.

Or, use the downloadable version with Excel or similar software.

I have double-checked all of the answers, but if any mistakes are
found I will email you right away with the updated key.

I suggest checking your answers after you complete the first
question in a section (to ensure you are on the right track) and
also check your answers after completing each section before
moving on.



                           GOOD LUCK!
```
